Action and paths
Consolidate unique cases from `aligned_models_synthetic_tests.R` into discoverable `test-aligned-models-synthetic.R`; avoid duplicate helper/test definitions. Match normalization and control RNG/solver tolerance in true equivalence tests.

Acceptance evidence / regression tests
The standard suite discovers the unique cases. Equal-normalization MCCA and controlled-initialization named-index equivalence pass. A separate test can measure documented stochastic/convergence sensitivity without falsely asserting exact equality across unrelated initializations.

Completion: record the tested source revision, precise regression names, retained receipts, and unresolved scientific assumptions. A smoke test does not establish calibration.
